messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks slowly forward and turns her head slightly to the right while her arms swing gently.","camera":"A medium shot from behind at roughly head height, following the character with slight movement.","clothing":"A short black-and-white checkered dress with a low open back and one off-the-shoulder sleeve.","hair_color":"Purple with lighter lavender highlights.","hairstyle":"Short hair styled into two low buns at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from behind with her face not visible.","scene":"An outdoor paved road on a sunny day, with trees, a guardrail, a street lamp, and a building in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a concrete platform beside the sea to a sunny paved road with trees, guardrails, a street lamp, and a building, matching the reference. The character remains a 3D female figure seen from behind, wearing the same black-and-white checkered dress and walking forward with similar arm movement. The lighting now appears consistent with a bright outdoor road scene, including a visible cast shadow.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the seaside scene with the reference road environment while preserving the character's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt the character's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the hair color change is an unintended change or an acceptable lighting adaptation to the new environment.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears more purple/lavender in the output than the deep blue in the source.
